key_insight: Topo-Spectral Percolation Descriptors (TSPD) can infer ion-transport mechanisms directly from a single static crystal structure by combining percolation analysis with barrier-weighted graph spectra.
engineering_relevance: This enables fast, calibration-free screening of batteries, solid electrolytes, membranes, and other ion-conducting materials for pathway connectivity and bottleneck-limited transport.
method: Build a periodic migration network from the crystal structure.
Compute physics-based edge barriers for possible ion jumps.
Analyze barrier-threshold percolation and the spectrum of the barrier-weighted graph Laplacian.
evidence_signal: The method was validated on eight materials against AIMD ion densities and neutron diffraction data, correctly reproducing transport dimensionality from 1D to 3D.
watch_item: TSPD is most informative for pathway-limited, direction-dependent transport and may be less predictive when strongly cooperative or nearly isotropic motion dominates.
paper_title: Topo-Spectral Percolation Descriptors for Mechanistic Ion Transport Pathways from Static Crystal Structures
